mapper.sql: f.`id` AS id, f.`ptxmmc` AS ptxmmc, f.`crzdbh` AS crzdbh, f.`dkmc` AS dkmc, f.`ptsslb` AS ptsslb, f.`xzqh` AS xzqh, f.`xmfl` AS xmfl, f.`jsdw` AS jsdw
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM `t_supporting_facilities` f
COALESCE(f.`delFlag`, '0') = '0'
AND (f.`ptxmmc` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR f.`crzdbh` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY f.`crzdbh`, f.`ptxmmc` LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `t_supporting_facilities` WHERE COALESCE(`delFlag`, '0') = '0' AND `crzdbh` = #{crzdbh}
